p: words of the covenant: That is, the articles, or conditions.
Horeb: At the first giving of the law, which was forty years earlier.
great temptations which thine eyes have: The proofs of my power.
given you an heart to perceive: He shows that it is not in man's power to understand the mysteries of God if it is not given to him from above.
bread: Made by man's art, but manna, which is called the bread of angels.
God: Who knows your hearts, and therefore you may not think to conceal from him.
enter into covenant with the LORD: Alluding to them, that when they made a sure covenant, divided a beast in two, and past between the parts divided, Ge 15:10.
that is not here with us: Meaning, their posterity.
a root that beareth gall and: Such sin, as the bitter fruit of it might choke and destroy you.
drunkenness to thirst: For as he that is thirsty desires to drink much so he that follows his appetites seeks by all means and yet cannot be satisfied.
generation to come of your children: God's plagues on those who rebel against him will be so strong, that all ages will be astonished.

secret things belong unto the LORD: Moses by this proves their curiosity, who seek those things that are only known to God: and their negligence who do not regard that which God has revealed to them, as the law.
